title: Proposed Structure
description: Schema for outputs/proposed_structure.json. Use updating-proposed-structure.md for workflow steps and proposed-structure.example.json for a concrete example.

inputs_reviewed.description: Input files used to build this proposal, including their role in the decision process.

path.description: Workspace-relative path to the input file that was reviewed.

role.description: Short explanation of how this input informed the proposal.

user_preferences_applied.description: Explicit user preferences or constraints applied while creating this proposal.

items.description: One preference or instruction applied to the proposal.

pages.description: Proposed pages, including both new pages and missing prerequisite pages.

slug.description: Unique slug for this page, used by metadata and dependency graph tooling.

title.description: Human-readable page title shown to users.

learning_objective.description: Single primary learning objective for the page.

description.description: Brief summary of page scope and learner outcome.

prerequisites.description: Ordered list of prerequisite page slugs needed before this page.

items.description: Slug of a required prerequisite page.

related_content.description: Suggested related page slugs for onward learning.

proposed_tags.description: Tag names to apply to the page in later publishing steps.

items.description: Single tag name to apply to this page.

status.description: Page classification: `new` for deliverable pages, `missing` for proposed prerequisite gaps.

omitted_source_sections.description: Source sections intentionally not mapped to a proposed page.

section.description: Name or identifier of the omitted source section.

reason.description: Why the section was omitted from this proposal.

tag_review.description: Summary of how proposed tags align to existing taxonomy.

new_tags_required.description: Tags needed for this proposal that are not present in current tags export.

items.description: Tag name that would need to be created.

existing_tags_used.description: Tags from the existing taxonomy that are used by proposed pages.

items.description: Tag name already available in the platform taxonomy.

notes.description: Additional rationale or caveats for tag decisions.

checkpoint_review.description: Checklist narrative confirming alignment with content-ingestion quality checkpoints.

language_agnostic_foundations_first.description: How foundational, language-agnostic concepts were placed before tool-specific content.

single_learning_objective.description: How each page was kept to one primary learning objective.

concrete_exercises.description: How practical, concrete exercises were ensured in proposed content.

exercise_naming_conventions.description: How exercise and page naming conventions were applied.

tagging_conventions.description: How tagging conventions were followed in proposed tags.
